name: Mintlify
description: Connect Mintlify to Claude to keep your documentation accurate and up to date without leaving your conversations. Claude can search across every page, read and edit content directly, and ship changes. Perfect for fixing outdated pages after a product change, reorganizing sections as your product grows, or drafting new content alongside the code it documents.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Mintlify to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Mintlify to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.mintlify.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Mintlify MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mintlify lists 15 MCP tools, including checkout, save, discard_session, read, search, list_nodes, get_session_state, diff, edit_page, write_page, create_node, and update_node.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Mintlify?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Mintlify in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
Mintlify requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Mintlify is developed by Mintlify. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
